answer: To enforce Sybil resistance, we establish a tundra of locked staking collateral that undergoes quadratic slashing during consensus deviations, ensuring that malicious behavior triggers a terminal capital loss. This mechanism forces the marginal cost of coordinating fake identities to spiral upward, far outstripping any potential extracted value. By coupling this with a zero-knowledge verifiable delay pulse that anchors epoch transitions, we prove that the expected utility of any coordinated attack remains strictly negative, cementing a robust Nash equilibrium.
